RATINGS

An opinion regarding securities or a person expressed in the form of
standard symbols or in any other standardized manner, assigned by a
credit rating company and includes credit rating [Ref: CRC Regulations
2016,Clause 2(1) i)]

A.

ACCEPTANCE OF AGREEMENT

1.

PACRA undertakes to complete the rating assignment from the CLIENT on the terms and conditions as
set out in this agreement, which is binding in nature on both parties for all the terms and conditions
contained therein.
In consideration for its rating, PACRA shall receive a fee as specified by the fee agreement which has
been signed separately. The terms of the fee agreement are binding upon the relevant parties.

2.
B.
3.

TERM OF RATING AGREEMENT
This agreement shall remain in effect from the beginning date to the expiry date as mentioned above
[Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 13(f)].

4.

The rating shall remain valid unless withdrawn / suspended by PACRA through a formal communication.
[Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; Clause 13.(J)] .

5.

6.
7.
8.

9.

C.

This agreement will be automatically renewed for the similar term thereafter unless notified otherwise by
either PACRA or the CLIENT. The notice of non-renewal must be received at least 60 days prior to the
expiry of the term.
The CLIENT could terminate this contract by giving at least 60 days advance written notice to the other
party.
PACRA may terminate this Agreement in case of a breach of any terms of this agreement including fee
agreement.
In case of lack of requisite information, non-provision of information, or non-co-operation by the CLIENT,
PACRA shall suspend the rating or withdraw from the engagement. PACRA also promptly notify this
fact to the public [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 13(1) c].
Where PACRA discontinues monitoring a rating for a rated entity, it shall either withdraw the rating or
disclose such discontinuation to the public or to its subscribers, as appropriate, immediately [Reference:
CRC Regulations 2016; clause17 (e)] .
FURNISHING OF INFORMATION

10. The CLIENT undertakes to provide PACRA true, accurate, complete, and updated information to enable
it to arrive at and maintain a fair and true rating of the CLIENT, as the case may be [Reference: CRC
Regulations 2016 Clause 13(1) a].

11. The CLIENT empowers PACRA to call and obtain, any time during the validity period of the Agreement
all such information as deemed necessary by it for conducting effective and timely review of the rating
assigned [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 13(1) b].

12. PACRA shall, engage with the CLIENT to remain updated on all information pertaining to the rating of
the entity [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 17(d)] .
13. PACRA shall, where feasible and appropriate, prior to issuing or revising a rating inform the issuer of the
critical information and principal considerations upon which a rating will be based and provide the
CLIENT an opportunity to clarify any likely factual misperception or other matter that the credit rating
company must know in order to produce a fair rating [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 19(1)].
D.

CONFIDENTIALITY

14. PACRA shall, except as required under these regulations and without obtaining prior written approval of
its CLIENT, not share with or disclose to media or any other party including its other clients, any
confidential information about its CLIENT, which has come to its knowledge in the course of the rating
process [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 11 (A) o].
E.

RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHER CREDIT RATING COMPANY

15. The CLIENT must furnish a No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from its existing credit rating company to
PACRA along with this agreement in case of termination of rating agreement prior to its expiry.
OR
The CLIENT ensures in writing that it shall continue credit rating with its existing credit rating company
for at least one year.
Provided that this clause shall not be applicable in case of a credit rating assignment obtained through
open bidding under the Public Procurement Rules, 2004 or any other applicable law relating to
procurement of services [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; Clause 13(1) e].
16. In case of dual private rating, authorizing the existing credit rating company to make public the private
rating assigned by it, in case its CLIENT approaches another credit rating company, during the life of the
agreement with the existing credit rating company, to make public the private rating assigned by such
other credit rating company [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; Clause 13(1)ei].
17. PACRA shall not get involved in acts of frauds, misrepresentations, oppressive or unethical practices, nor
shall solicit the customers of any other rating company on implicit or explicit assurance of higher rating
or any other undue benefit [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; Clause 10(7)g] .
F.

DISSEMINATION

18. Once an initial rating is communicated to the CLIENT, it has the prerogative to make this rating public or
keep it private. In case the rating is not made public, any selective disclosure would not be allowed.
However, PACRA may disclose the existence of rating agreement and opinion. Nevertheless, the CLIENT
may request PACRA to make rating public anytime. PACRA expects a decision within five working
days. In case, the CLIENT decides to go for public dissemination, PACRA does so through its website
and other media. The dissemination provides all the benefits of a publicly available independent rating
opinion. In case the rating is not made public, any selective disclosure would not be allowed. Nevertheless,
the CLIENT may request PACRA to make rating public anytime.
19. PACRA shall disseminate all ratings assigned by it, whether solicited or unsolicited, except the private
ratings, by way of press release through Associated Press of Pakistan and All Pakistan Newspapers
Society [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 14(1)].
20. PACRA shall immediately disseminate all ratings to the Securities Exchanges, the State Bank of Pakistan,
the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, Mutual Fund Association of Pakistan, Pakistan
Banking Association, Non-Banking Financial Institutions and Modarba Association of Pakistan
[Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 14(2)].

21. PACRA shall disseminate latest rating report and rating press releases, except the reports and press
releases relating to private ratings, for at least last five years, containing the names and contact detail of
rating analyst, purpose of rating, assumption and rationale for the rating assigned etc. [Reference: CRC
Regulations 2016; clause 14(3)(f)].

22. The CLIENT authorizes PACRA in case of dual private rating to make public the private rating assigned
by it, in case the CLIENT approaches another credit rating company, during the life of this agreement with

Page 2 of 4

PACRA to make public the private rating assigned by such other credit rating company [Reference: CRC
Regulations 2016; clause 16(3)].

G.

SURVEILLANCE

23. The CLIENT consents, authorizing PACRA to conduct review of the rating any time during the validity
period of this agreement [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clause 13(d)].
24. PACRA shall monitor all the outstanding ratings continuously and any potential change therein due to
any event associated with the issuer, the security arrangement, the industry etc., is disseminated to the
market, immediately and in effective manner, after appropriate consultation with the entity/issuer
[Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clauses 17(a)] .
25. PACRA shall review all the outstanding ratings on semi-annual basis or upon occurrence of such an event
which requires to do so; However, public dissemination of semi-annual review will be required only in
case of any change in the underlying rating [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; clauses 17(b)].
26. PACRA shall initiate immediate review of the outstanding rating upon becoming aware of any
information that may reasonably be expected to result in downgrading of the rating [Reference: CRC
Regulations 2016; clauses 17(c)].

27. In case the CLIENT has any disagreement with any of the rating opinion it has the option to “Rating
Review Request”. The rating review request has to be in writing and shall be considered legitimate
whenever such request arises out of a belief that:
i.
PACRA has inadvertently missed or materially misinterpreted critical information in reaching a
rating decision.
ii.
There exist new information, new background to existing information or material developments not
reflected in the outstanding rating.
28. The decision in such review will be considered final. Any disagreement with rating opinion does not
restrict PACRA’s right to disseminate its updated opinion on rating.
H.

DISPUTE RESOLUTION

29. In the event of any dispute between the Parties arising under or in relation to the terms or performance of
this Agreement, the same shall in the first instance be attempted to be resolved in good faith through
mutual agreement. In the event that a mutual agreement cannot be arrived within 14 days of arising such
dispute, the matter shall be referred to arbitration according to the provision of Arbitration Act, 1940.
Provided that nothing in this Section shall apply to any dispute pertaining to the rating assigned by
PACRA as part of its assignment or to any dispute which pertains to the rating process. In all such matters
the decision of PACRA shall be final and no claim shall lie against it.
30. Without prejudice to the general exclusion of liability set forth in this agreement, if it is held that PACRA
is liable to compensate the CLIENT for negligence or breach of the terms hereof, the maximum liability
of the PACRA in this regard shall be restricted to the fees received by PACRA pursuant to this agreement,
in the preceding 12 months.
I.

CONFLICT OF INTEREST

31.

PACRA shall not provide rating services to a company where any of its director is holding a directorship
or is a substantial shareholder or is in any way interested in such company subject to rating [Reference:
CRC Regulations 2016; clause 10(2)].

The acceptance by PACRA of any rating assignment from the CLIENT shall be preconditioned on the fact
that, as stipulated under Clause 10(3) of CRC Regulations 2016, no person directly or indirectly, holding
more than 10% of share capital of PACRA also holds directly or indirectly 10% or more of the share
capital of the entity which is subject to rating by PACRA.
33. The CLIENT agrees that during the validity of this agreement and up to one year after the termination of
relationship with PACRA, the CLIENT will not offer employment to any of the employee who remained
involved in client’s rating process [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016; Annexure I clauses 3(iv)].
32.

Page 3 of 4

J.

DISCLAIMER

34. PACRA’s rating and related analysis are statements of opinion about the relative standing of the entity
and its affairs as of the date they are expressed. These are not recommendations to buy or
subscribe/unsubscribe any services. The rating is based on information that has been obtained from the
CLIENT and sources we consider to be reliable but its accuracy or completeness is not guaranteed.
PACRA shall owe no liability whatsoever to any loss or damage caused by or resulting from any error in
such information.
K.

GENERAL TERMS

35. PACRA undertakes to fulfill its obligations in a fair, efficient, transparent and ethical manner and render
high standards of services in performing its functions and obligations [Reference: CRC Regulations 2016;
clause 11 (A) a].

36. Where any conflict arises between the terms of this rating agreement and any applicable regulations, and
any further amendments thereof, PACRA shall take all such measures deem necessary to be compliant
with the relevant regulations. In any such case, regulations would take precedence over the terms of this
agreement.
37. No amendment, modification or waiver in respect of this Agreement will be effective unless in writing
and confirmed by each of the party.
The parties hereto executed this agreement through their “Authorized Representatives” as of the date of
signing of this rating agreement.
